title: PR body claims per-attempt draw counts unchanged; the code comments and decision log state the member-pick draw count DID change
evidence:
+Plus two zero-draw rejection predicates in `core/growth.odin` that close the
+stray classes the strict audit exposes (draw order/counts per attempt
+unchanged — the rng interleaving shifts only through acceptance):

vs core/growth.odin:
+// documented 08-21 re-bless). ONE draw-count change vs 5.12, in the attach
+// family: the member pick counts LIVE MEMBERS only (the dead-slot id-0
+// collision guard) — its rng_range flips from drawn to SKIPPED when a
+// cluster's 5.12 member set included a dead slot; every other per-attempt
+// count is unchanged.
detail: PR body asserts counts unchanged and calls the live-terminal anchor guard a 'zero-draw predicate'; growth.odin and the decision log document a drawn→SKIPPED member-pick flip. Spec Design Notes repeat 'no rng draws'.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR body (and spec note) to match the decision log: predicates add no draws, but the anchor guard changes the member-pick rng_range and can skip that draw.

title: Unit test spawns its router fixture at y=30 on a stated 40×30-tile map — one row past the last valid 0-based row
evidence:
+	topology_spawn_node(&s.topology, rt_idx, {20, 30}, cat)  // a router — NOT an "existing home"

+**Seed distance default 10:** 2× the adjacency radius — visually distinct sections on the 40×30-tile map while staying within the era-3 connect span (18) for E31. The rejection budget keeps it honest on dense maps (deterministic skip, no stall).
detail: With h_tiles=30 (0-based rows 0..29), the router at {20,30} sits off-grid; the test silently relies on topology_spawn_node not bounds-validating. Distance math still works, but the fixture is out-of-map.
recommended_fix: Move the router to an in-bounds cell (e.g. {20,29}) and adjust the near-router candidate, or document the deliberate off-grid fixture.
